name: they-hang-up
about: They put the phone down mid-notice. A partial transcript is written, nothing crashes, nothing retries on its own - and, the part only the audio run can see, the agent stops GENERATING audio the moment the line closes. Until this fixture set hangUpAtMs the no_audio_after_hangup check had never been observed acting on a real call loop.

audio.about: The far end hangs up 12 seconds in, part-way through the notice. Only `npm run call` reads this; the text harness ignores it.
